title: Saturday, slightly elsewhere.
subtitle: A day trip through the South Bay that hasn't happened yet.
intro: Take the scenic entrance. Catch the tiny ferry. Stay until the courtyard lights come on. Twenty-four stops through today's imagined coast, with all 360 generated images waiting in the archive.
disclosure: Speculative worlds made with Midjourney. These are imagined places, objects and campaigns, not built projects, real offers or endorsed products. Collectible designs are fictional art, not currency or investments.

chapters.title: Take the scenic entrance
chapters.intro: The itinerary begins with one chair, one palm and absolutely no urgent business. Then the walls open up.

images.title: Rain Garden Pool
images.caption: One chair. One palm. The agenda is looking manageable.
images.alt: Coral courtyard walls surround a shallow green tiled pool, with one palm, a small wooden platform and an ochre chair.

images.title: Main Street Morning Desk
images.caption: The office has opened its entire front wall. A promising start.
images.alt: A painted coral storefront opens onto a long blue worktable; a bicycle rests outside beneath a palm.

images.title: Garden Room, Low Roof
images.caption: A roof that would rather stretch out than show off.
images.alt: A low timber building with long horizontal rooflines sits among trees and a coastal garden.

images.title: A Section Through the Local Signal
images.caption: For anyone wondering where they hid the basketball court: behind the drawing.
images.alt: An exploded blue and coral architectural drawing reveals rooms, a courtyard, lifted roof and a basketball court.

chapters.outro: A fine start. Now for a wildly inefficient commute.

chapters.title: The long way round
chapters.intro: Choose your mode of arrival. None of these imaginary vehicles appears especially concerned with shaving three minutes off the trip.

images.title: Surf Microvan
images.caption: Board meeting. The kind with fins.
images.alt: A cream microvan with a coral roof carries surfboards along a palm lined coastal road.

images.title: Harbor Cargo Trike
images.caption: Small wheels. Heroic orange box.
images.alt: A blue cargo tricycle with an orange load box is illustrated beside a turquoise harbor wall.

images.title: Dune Shuttle
images.caption: The shuttle seems to have mistaken itself for a very agreeable living room.
images.alt: A mint green rounded shuttle with a wide open door sits among low dunes under a blue sky.

images.title: One-Bay Ferry
images.caption: A whole bay, one glorious left turn.
images.alt: A small cream roofed ferry leaves a sweeping sea green wake across a textured blue sea.

chapters.outro: You have arrived. The lesson plan is mostly sunlight.

chapters.title: Your afternoon syllabus
chapters.intro: Today's subjects: reflections, wandering, taking things apart, and whatever happens on that very orange field.

images.title: The Learning Court
images.caption: Office hours, with a reflecting pool doing half the thinking.
images.alt: A palm reflects in a turquoise pool surrounded by coral campus buildings and people sitting under shade.

images.title: Coastal Garden Classroom
images.caption: The lecture has escaped into the garden. Follow it.
images.alt: People gather in a lush coastal garden of winding paths and flowering plants above a low town and blue sea.

images.title: One Block of Learning
images.caption: Lift the roofs. Find more places to get pleasantly sidetracked.
images.alt: An exploded architectural drawing shows pale roofs floating over coral and green shared campus spaces.

images.title: Play Opens the Lesson
images.caption: Attendance looks excellent from the bleachers.
images.alt: A colorful campus sports scene combines orange bleachers, a low field house and a geometric playing field.
images.adHeadline: A field for every kind of question.
images.adCopy: Imagine a neighborhood campus where a game and a seminar can share the afternoon.

chapters.kicker: University of El Segundo · imagined campus
chapters.outro: Class dismissed. There is something good happening in the workshop.

chapters.title: Make something. Take a break.
chapters.intro: A workshop with daylight, a radio with a proper knob, and a loading court with a second career. Useful is allowed to be cheerful.

images.title: Smoky Hollow Prototype Morning
images.caption: The workbench has room for another idea. Probably.
images.alt: Two people work at a broad wooden bench in a sunlit industrial workshop filled with tools, prototypes and plants.

images.title: Lunch Break at the Loading Court
images.caption: The loading court has entered its basketball era.
images.alt: People and bicycles gather around a blue and coral basketball court between low cream workshop buildings.

images.title: Useful Objects, Open Window
images.caption: A satisfying knob is still a pretty good interface.
images.alt: Hands hold a small orange and cream object above drawings; colorful radios and prototypes sit beside a sunlit window.

images.title: Repair Is a Local Skill
images.caption: The repair queue has brought its own radio.
images.alt: A radio, lamp and bicycle wheels sit outside a coral doored repair workshop under overhead wires.
images.adCopy: An imagined neighborhood repair room for patient hands and useful knowledge.

chapters.outro: A little useful work deserves an imaginary souvenir.

chapters.title: Souvenirs from a possible place
chapters.intro: No checkout required. These fictional collectibles are here for the color, the texture and the pleasure of keeping a little piece of an imaginary afternoon.

images.title: Harbor Token Set
images.caption: Pocket-sized sea air. No exchange rate; just rope and sailboats.
images.alt: Four fictional round art tokens depict a knotted rope, sailboats and a blank brass colored surface.

images.title: Seed Exchange Folio
images.caption: A garden, flattened just enough to fit in a folder.
images.alt: Overlapping botanical prints show leaves, seed forms and a palm in green, blue and coral.

images.title: The Paper and Token Studio
images.caption: The next edition is drying. Please admire responsibly.
images.alt: Colorful abstract paper prints cover a worktable in a bright studio with a printing press and potted plants.

images.title: The Local Souvenir Reimagined
images.caption: Some souvenirs contain an entire basketball court.
images.alt: A miniature cutaway art world stacks coral and blue rooms, a garden and a green basketball court.
images.adCopy: A fictional collection of paper art, patterns and coastal ideas.

chapters.kicker: Paper, tokens, a whole tiny world
chapters.outro: The best souvenir might be a place to sit a while.

chapters.title: Stay until the lights come on
chapters.intro: One garden detour. One chapter before dinner. One last blue reflection. An excellent place to lose track of the time.

images.title: Pocket Garden Almanac
images.caption: The back door opens onto a better plan.
images.alt: Open coral doors frame a lush garden courtyard with a long table, blue chairs and a small reflecting pool.

images.title: Evening Reading Room
images.caption: A reading room with a very convincing argument against leaving.
images.alt: Readers sit in ochre chairs on a cobalt floor beside tall coral bookshelves and a blue dusk view.

images.title: Community Light Table
images.caption: Three lamps and a conversation that can take its time.
images.alt: Three colorful glowing lamps stand on a wooden table while people converse in a courtyard beyond open coral doors.

images.title: The Blue Hour Brief
images.caption: Last stop: the chair with the best reflection.
images.alt: An orange chair overlooks a blue pool reflecting a warmly lit glass studio at dusk.
images.adCopy: An imagined pool court where the day's local conversations spark tomorrow's stories.

chapters.outro: The itinerary ends here. The afternoon does not have to.
